messages:
Sam K: quick sync — did: emptied noisy prewarm queue in us-west-2, reprovisioned 4 g5s for canary, noticed provisioning errors in eu-west-1 (quota exceed). Blocker: can't scale past 32 vCPUs in that project, cloud console shows requested limits pending. Today: will open quota ticket and fallback plan.
Maria L: TY — filing a support case now, but cloud usually takes 4-6h. Suggest we shift non-critical canaries to ap-southeast-1 for the next 6h. Can you attach the job ids?
Sam K: job ids: 4821, 4822, 4830. Also seeing prewarm attempts failing with 409 on our orchestration side.
Alex R: pinged on the terraform PR for az-affinity change: https://git/redwood/infra/pull/512 — can someone review? it's small: set resource tag and preferred_az list.
Ben P: saw the canary logs, model fallback path triggered due to OOMs. Rolling back that quantization tweak fixed the instance memory. Proposal: temp pin model to 1.3.2 for canaries.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17T13:07Z started: canary/model-service v1.3.3 -> v1.4.0 (triggered by Ben P)
Maria L: agreed with pin. Sam, if you shift jobs to ap-southeast-1, make sure to set --region=ap-southeast-1 and tag with team=eng-infra. Use this snippet:
```
redwoodctl provision --jobs 4821,4822,4830 --region ap-southeast-1 --tags "team=eng-infra,env=canary"
```
Sam K: doing the shift now, will also open quota ticket with support case #INC-9182. ETA to finish shift ~20m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Alex R: review +1 on the PR, small nits fixed, merging.
Ben P: after shift, I'll rerun canary and post results.
Sam K: shift done. All three jobs are now running in ap-southeast-1. No more 409s. handing to Ben for validation.
Ben P: canary runs green ✅ initial latency looks fine — profiling now, will share perf diff in #eng-runtime.
Maria L: support updated quota to 48 for eu-west-1, effective in 2h. We'll plan to move steady-state back then.
Sam K: thanks team — closing my blockers. Nothing else on my plate today.
